description: Cross-disciplinary structural vocabulary for scientifically grounded equation evolution.

scopes.unary: One quantity changes its own response or contribution.
scopes.pairwise: A process depends jointly on two declared quantities.
scopes.multiway: A process depends on three or more declared quantities.
scopes.state_coupling: An ODE state feeds back into another state or its own RHS.
scopes.time_forcing: An explicitly time-varying driver modulates a law.
scopes.memory: A delayed, accumulated, or filtered quantity is represented by a declared state.

structural_roles.contribution: An additional causal contribution to the target balance.
structural_roles.response_law: A nonlinear or regime-dependent mapping from cause to response.
structural_roles.modulation: An existing contribution is modulated by a condition or covariate.
structural_roles.interaction: Two or more quantities jointly alter a contribution.
structural_roles.constraint: A finite capacity, bound, bottleneck, or resource limitation.
structural_roles.transition: A smooth or sharp crossover between scientifically distinct regimes.
structural_roles.feedback: The output or state changes the process that produces it.
structural_roles.heterogeneity: A coefficient or response varies across an observed or latent regime.
structural_roles.timescale: A finite relaxation, response, or competing timescale is made explicit.
structural_roles.transport_balance: Accumulation is changed by inflow, outflow, diffusion, or transfer.

operation_definitions.add_term: Add a previously omitted generative process while preserving the parent variables and states.
operation_definitions.change_assumption: Relax a simplifying assumption already present in the parent law; promotion is allowed only when scientifically justified.
